witnesses.title: Timing algebra + crossfade property check (corrected assertions)
witnesses.input: same fixtures; layout() helper; trim-shift 12000 frames before clip 3
witnesses.stdout: P1 cue-history-independence: PASS; P2 monotone floor mapping: PASS; P3 exclusive-out boundary == next clip start: PASS; P4 concatenated total stable: FAIL 223944000 vs 223464000; P5 equal-power crossfade maxerr: 2.22e-16 PASS; P6 missing-source guard: PASS; P7 layout totals shift-consistent: PASS

witnesses.scope_limits: isolated component check; no real audio content assembled; does not establish application behavior

witnesses.title: Capture-identity recomputation of peaks.js release JSON
witnesses.input: hand-transcribed body text of S1 capture
witnesses.expected_behavior: sha256 == tool-reported d36f237e... if transcription exact
witnesses.interpretation: MISMATCH caused by 6-byte candidate transcription loss (1762 vs 1768). Conclusion: capture identities in sources.json rest on the capture tool's reported sha256 over exact HTTP response bytes; no independent byte-level fidelity claim is made by the candidate.
witnesses.scope_limits: sandbox has no network; original bytes not re-fetchable in isolation
